messages:
Emma: Heads-up — KiteScale onboarding: p95 tail climbed to 420ms on gen-2 calls during peak (7-9am PST). Cost per 1k requests up ~28% last 48h. Looking for quick mitigations: quant + model swap + routing. cc @raj @max
Raj: Thanks — saw the alert. We have CPU/GPU usage flat; spikes correlate w/ longer sequences from their summarization pipeline. p95 token count ~560.
Max: If token distribution high, can try switching to gpt-small-v2 for short summaries, keep gpt-medium for long ones. Also can trial int8 quantization — small perf delta on quality but big cost win. happy to run A/B.
Olivia: I'll schedule enablement session with KiteScale CSM next Tue 10am PT to walk them through behavior changes. Want a safe canary plan we can share.
Emma: Plan idea: route requests with input_length < 256 -> small model; >=256 -> medium. Fallback to hosted larger model on errors. Also enable prefix KV cache for repeated contexts. Thoughts?
Raj: Works. Here's a quick route config I can push to prod canary:

```json
{
  "routes": [
    { "name": "short-path", "cond": "input_len < 256", "model": "gpt-small-v2", "weight": 0.85 },
    { "name": "long-path", "cond": "input_len >= 256", "model": "gpt-medium-v2", "weight": 0.15 }
  ],
  "fallback": { "model": "gpt-large-v1", "timeout_ms": 1500 }
}
```

Raj: I'll also set canary=10% for 24h.
Max: For quant, I'll run a quick eval vs their prompt set. If top-line avg quality drop <2%, we can push int8. ETA 36h.
Emma: Nice. Ops-bot: created ticket CS-4578 for canary + quant evaluation. :ticket:
ops-bot: [ticket link] https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/CS-4578
Olivia: I'll prep a one-pager for KiteScale: expected latency/cost delta and rollback steps.
Emma: Great — next check-in here Friday EOD. Thanks team :thumbsup:
